note_ifc_rel_connects_ports: One IfcRelConnectsPorts per logical connection. IFC4 bounds IfcPort.ConnectedTo and IfcPort.ConnectedFrom at SET [0:1] each, so a reciprocal pair per connection would saturate both role slots on both ports. The previous count of 12 pinned the doubled reciprocal pairs the old connect_port helper wrote for 6 logical connections.
note_ifc_distribution_port: 14 = 2 canonical ports + 6 route-span ports + 4 fitting ports + 2 route attachment ports. Each route end attaches to an adapter-owned port of its own, nested on the canonical port's owner at the canonical port's position, instead of to the canonical port itself; otherwise a canonical panel port could start at most two home runs within IFC4's per-role bound. The route-end connections moved to the attachment ports, so IfcRelConnectsPorts stays 6. The previous count of 12 had no attachment ports.
